content: {"summary":"Users report that after recent updates, game and system sounds disappear on all controller/headset combos while party chat remains functional, causing frustration after multiple support calls [tk_2905366]. Many complain that their microphones no longer register, producing muffled or static‑laden audio, even when using different headsets or adapters, and some can hear others but not vice versa [tk_511546, tk_2690583, tk_2595927, tk_2699993]. Elite controllers paired with chat adapters often fail to transmit mic input, though party chat works when the headset is connected directly to the controller [tk_2275025]. Additionally, some users experience menu navigation issues and self‑talking through headsets post‑update, indicating broader audio and interface glitches [tk_1181212, tk_2232838]."}
